subject.summary: Pharmacists (O*NET 29-1051.00) review prescriptions for accuracy and appropriateness, verify patient information, allergy history, drugs, and directions, dispense or supervise dispensing, perform the final check, explain medication information to patients, and communicate anomalies to the care team. The specific scope of practice, prescription review, and dispensing authority are determined by local law, licences, and organizational policy; this page does not provide individual treatment advice.
